title: Sirene - Act 2 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Sirene in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 2, Sirene.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sirene is the second Axon and the boss that gates the end of Act 2. She is a caster who fights through summoned creatures and a Charm mechanic, and whether she is a hard fight or a manageable one is decided before you enter the arena.

sections.title: Where to Find the Sirene
sections.content: Location: the Sirene area, Act 2, past Glissando. Beating her is required to reach the Paintress.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce, Dark
ResistsEarth, Light

Ice and Dark are her weaknesses; Earth and Light are resisted. She also drops Tisseron, a Sciel weapon, which makes Sciel a natural pick for both the damage and the drop.

sections.title: How to Beat the Sirene
sections.content:
Fight the Tisseur first

Before you reach Sirene you are offered the choice to kill or spare the Tisseur. Fighting it is strongly worth it: you gain the Anti-Charm Pictos, and if you spare it Sirene can buff her own defences during the fight. Sparing the Tisseur makes the boss measurably harder.

Charm

Sirene charms through the Ballet enemies that accompany her. Charm costs you control of a character and is the main way this fight goes wrong - the Anti-Charm effect from the Tisseur is the direct counter.

She calls creatures

Sirene herself is not the only damage source. She summons creatures from her realm, so clearing adds keeps the fight readable rather than letting pressure stack.

  • Ice and Dark; avoid Earth and Light.
  • Kill the Tisseur for Anti-Charm - sparing it makes Sirene tougher.
  • Clear her summoned creatures rather than ignoring them.
